audit_name: Team A5 Independent Adversarial Audit — Performance & Scalability, Offline Resilience, Frontend/UX
audited_tree: observed working tree (dirty: tracked archive renames/modifications and untracked deliverables), not committed HEAD alone
method: READ-ONLY static adversarial review; no source/git/config/DB modification; no network; no operational DB; no benchmark or browser execution; synthetic reasoning only

verdict.note: No status of INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED or PRODUCTION READY is awarded to audited work. All performance/availability figures are NOT MEASURED.

known_disclosures_not_rereported: 10_RELIABILITY_OFFLINE_SURVEY.md:16-21 durable anchor BLOCKED, crash durability NOT IMPLEMENTED, RPO/RTO NOT IMPLEMENTED
13_INTEGRATION_TEST_AND_VERIFICATION.md:108 T3 synthetic in-process queue; no runtime wiring
disclosure_discipline.synthetic_data_honesty: Checked and not reported: synthetic/demo surfaces are explicitly labelled (e.g. HealthEcosystemPage.tsx:168, LabOperationsWorkspacePage.tsx:145,150, DeviceIntegrationWorkspacePage.tsx:51)

findings.title: Availability SLO computed from a hardcoded gauge; 99.99% target is unobservable
findings.evidence_detail: metrics_service emits literal 'gula_up 1' / 'gula_down 0'; slo:availability_window applies rate() over those gauges; SLOAvailabilityBelow therefore cannot observe real downtime; latency/error counters are process-local dicts.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Read the cited lines: gula_up is never set to 0 by any probe. Falsify by demonstrating a real health probe driving gula_up/down and a recorded availability series, or an external black-box SLI.
findings.root_cause: Availability modelled as a static self-report rather than a probed signal; counters not aggregated across workers.
findings.impact: The 99.99% availability target provides false assurance and its alert cannot fire for real outages. Actual availability is NOT MEASURED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Drive gula_up/down from black-box probe results without changing the owner-approved 99.99% target; aggregate counters across workers before recording error-budget rules; add a regression test that flips the probe and asserts the alert fires.
alternatives: Compute availability from ingress/load-balancer access logs instead of app gauges
Rename the app metric to gula_self_report_up and exclude it from SLO rules

findings.title: Performance certification claims contradict source defaults; supporting evidence is failing or absent
findings.evidence_detail: Code defaults are WEB_CONCURRENCY=2, DB_POOL_SIZE=5, DB_MAX_OVERFLOW=10; certification claims Workers 3 and DB pool 18 with 'Status: PASS'; the only benchmark result artifact reports overall_status FAIL; no k6 result artifact found.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Compare the four sources. Falsify with a checked-in timestamped k6 summary artifact and a deployment manifest showing the env overrides that produce workers=3/pool=18.
findings.root_cause: Certification authored from intended rather than effective configuration; no result artifact bound to the PASS claim.
findings.impact: PASS status is unsupported and no stated number is reproducible. Throughput and latency are NOT MEASURED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Regenerate the certification from a reproducible load artifact; reconcile worker/pool values with code defaults or document exact env overrides; set status to BLOCKED until a passing run exists.
alternatives: Relabel the document as an unmeasured design target with no PASS status
Pin configuration in code so documentation and runtime cannot diverge

findings.title: Per-call Redis client creation, sequential bulk operations, and blocking Redis calls inside async methods
findings.evidence_detail: _get_redis() constructs a new client per cache op; stats_summary issues nine sequential scalar COUNT queries; get_many/set_many loop sequentially; _l2_get/_l2_set call synchronous redis_cache.get/set inside async def.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Static call-site trace. Falsify by showing a module-level pooled client, a grouped aggregate query, and non-blocking L2 access.
findings.root_cause: Convenience helpers written synchronously then wrapped in async signatures without I/O offload or connection reuse.
findings.impact: Connection churn, event-loop stalls under load, nine round-trips per stats cache miss. Latency amplification is NOT MEASURED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use one module-level Redis client with a bounded pool; collapse the nine counts into one grouped aggregate query; pipeline bulk cache ops and offload blocking L2 calls; add a regression test asserting one client construction and bounded query count.
alternatives: Cache the whole summary blob keyed by (lab_id, window)
Materialise dashboard counters in a scheduled aggregate table

findings.title: Async compatibility layer runs blocking SQL; read replica is defined but unused
findings.evidence_detail: _AwaitableProxy wraps an already-computed sync result; get_read_db() exists with a docstring directing read routes to it; a comment claims routes use it; repo-wide search finds no route dependency on it.
findings.reproduction_falsification: grep -rn 'get_read_db' backend/app --include='*.py' returns only the definition and the comment. Falsify by identifying a route dependency.
findings.root_cause: Read-scaling path added but never wired; async-looking API is a compatibility shim over sync SQLAlchemy sessions.
findings.impact: Read scaling is inert and async endpoints can block workers on DB I/O. Read capacity is NOT MEASURED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Wire read-only endpoints through get_read_db and verify replica lag, or remove the dead dependency and comment; move blocking session work to a threadpool where async behaviour is required.
alternatives: Adopt a fully async SQLAlchemy engine for affected paths
Declare those routes as def (FastAPI threadpool) rather than async

findings.title: Metrics endpoint is process-local and performs synchronous work per scrape
findings.evidence_detail: Counters are module-level per-process dicts; ping_redis performs a sync ping; get_queue_backlog opens a new SessionLocal and COUNTs on every scrape; SLO latency/error-budget rules consume these counters.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Trace the cited functions. Falsify by showing cross-worker metric aggregation and a background backlog collector.
findings.impact: SLO records reflect an arbitrary single worker; scrapes add DB load proportional to scrape frequency. Error budget and p99 are NOT MEASURED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Export per-worker series and aggregate in Prometheus or a shared backend; collect backlog in a background task; bound scrape duration.
alternatives: Use the existing OTLP/HTTP tracing pipeline for latency instead of in-process buckets
Derive error budget from ingress logs rather than app counters

findings.title: Load test covers health/read paths only; write path and concurrency unverified; no result artifact
findings.evidence_detail: k6 default function groups are liveness/read-only; performance-budget tests are pure SQLAlchemy + TestClient query-count guards; only benchmark result artifact reports FAIL and no k6 summary export exists.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Inspect the k6 script for mutating verbs and search for k6 result artifacts. Falsify with a write-mixed k6 run and checked-in summary.
findings.root_cause: Performance assurance scoped to read surfaces and micro-benchmarks.
findings.impact: Throughput under write contention, lock behaviour, and stampede resistance are NOT MEASURED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add a write-heavy scenario with realistic tenant/lab mix and idempotency keys; check in the k6 summary; gate certification on its thresholds. Never run against production data.
alternatives: Use a synthetic single-tenant dataset for write load
Add queue-depth/lock-wait instrumentation as a leading indicator

findings.title: Unbounded page size on administrative lab listing
findings.evidence_detail: list_all_labs declares limit: int = 50 as a plain default with no Query(..., le=...) upper bound.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Call GET /admin/labs?limit=1000000 with an authorised principal; no upper bound is applied. Falsify by showing a global query-param clamp middleware.
findings.root_cause: Missing bound on a FastAPI query parameter.
findings.impact: Unbounded result materialisation/serialisation and memory pressure; cheap amplification vector for authorised users.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use Query(50, ge=1, le=500) consistent with other list endpoints and add a test for 422 rejection above the cap.
alternatives: Enforce a global list-endpoint cap middleware
Use cursor pagination for this endpoint

findings.title: Default conflict resolution is LAST_WRITE_WINS, contradicting the 'no lost updates' safety claim
findings.evidence_detail: _detect_conflict returns ConflictRecord(resolution=LAST_WRITE_WINS) for causally-unrelated concurrent operations; an honest CONFLICT_QUARANTINE branch exists at lines 200-246 (status string at 238) but is not the default; the survey asserts honest CONFLICT_QUARANTINE with 'no lost updates'.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Create two SyncOperations for the same entity with unrelated vector clocks, call _detect_conflict, and observe LAST_WRITE_WINS. Falsify by showing the runtime flow always overrides to quarantine before apply, or a test proving no overwrite occurs.
findings.root_cause: Safe strategy implemented but the detector default was left at last-write-wins; assurance documentation describes the safe branch as the default.
findings.impact: Concurrent offline edits can silently overwrite one another while documentation asserts the opposite; clinical result/order data loss is possible. Runtime impact is NOT MEASURED (static finding).
findings.recommended_remediation: With owner approval, default to CONFLICT_QUARANTINE, correct the survey sentence, and add a regression test asserting concurrent same-entity operations are quarantined with audit and neither is discarded. Keep KEEP_LAST_WITH_AUDIT explicit-only.
alternatives: Fail closed on unresolved conflict and require human adjudication
Implement CRDT only for non-clinical fields, excluding results/orders

findings.title: 'Durable' queue is synthetic and non-wired; replay reconstructs events with empty payloads
findings.evidence_detail: Module docstring states the log is an in-process byte buffer with no filesystem/database/broker/network/keyed signature/external anchor and 'NOT production-grade durability'; replay builds QueueEvent(payload={}); T3 is documented as synthetic with no runtime wiring; no runtime import outside package/tests.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Read the cited docstring and replay constructor and run an import search. Falsify by showing production wiring into real delivery plus an external anchor whose payload survives process restart.
findings.root_cause: Module is a correctness harness for queue semantics, not a persistence implementation; naming overstates capability.
findings.impact: No offline durable event delivery at runtime; even synthetic crash recovery loses payload content. Durability is NOT IMPLEMENTED / BLOCKED (already disclosed).
findings.recommended_remediation: After owner authorisation, implement a keyed tenant-scoped durable external anchor with encrypted payload persistence, wire into real delivery, and add a true process-restart test; until then avoid 'durable' as a production claim.
alternatives: Adopt an existing self-hosted durable broker consistent with Free/Open-Source/No-Vendor-Lock-In policy
Extend the existing outbox table pattern if made crash-safe

findings.title: No client-side offline data capability; 'offline-first' is not implemented in the browser
findings.evidence_detail: SW registration is the only offline bootstrap; Workbox caches static globs, images and Google Fonts only; repo-wide search of frontend-v3/src for indexedDB/idb/Dexie/localforage/navigator.onLine/background sync returns zero matches.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Load the built app offline and open a patient/order view: shell renders but no data loads or queues. Falsify by identifying a client store and offline queue surviving reload and re-syncing online.
findings.root_cause: Offline implemented as backend in-process harnesses plus static-asset PWA shell; no browser persistence layer.
findings.impact: No patient/order/result data offline and no offline action survives reload. Client offline capability is NOT IMPLEMENTED.
findings.recommended_remediation: With owner approval, implement an encrypted IndexedDB outbox with idempotency keys, cache only required reference/read data, wire to the server quarantine conflict path, and add an offline→online browser test.
alternatives: Declare the web client online-only and scope offline-first to a dedicated native/edge client
Ship a read-only offline reference cache explicitly excluding clinical writes

findings.title: Operation signature is a homebrew digest that omits timestamp and vector clock; forgeable with default empty secret
findings.evidence_detail: _sign_operation computes sha256 of op_id:data:device_id:secret rather than an HMAC; device_secret defaults to empty string; timestamp (client time.time()) and vector_clock are not in signed material.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Instantiate OfflineSyncEngine() with no secret and compute a valid digest from public fields; alter op.timestamp or vector_clock and observe _verify_signature still true. Falsify by showing a proper HMAC over all integrity-sensitive fields with a provisioned per-device key.
findings.root_cause: Ad-hoc digest used as authenticity control without key management or field-coverage design.
findings.impact: Operation data can be forged and causality fields tampered with when the secret is empty or leaked, undermining conflict detection. Deployment integrity is NOT MEASURED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Use hmac.new(key, canonical_bytes, sha256) over op_id, entity_id, operation, data, device_id, timestamp and vector_clock; require a non-empty per-device key, fail closed if absent, and use compare_digest.
alternatives: Use a standard signed envelope (JWS with per-device key)
Rely on transport mTLS plus server-assigned timestamps and drop the custom signature

findings.title: Encrypted sync store silently falls back to plaintext when no key is configured
findings.evidence_detail: _encrypt and _decrypt return data unchanged when self._key is falsy.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Instantiate EncryptedSyncStore() with no key, put bytes, and observe plaintext storage. Falsify by showing a mandatory validated key or fail-closed constructor.
findings.root_cause: Optional-encryption design where key absence degrades silently instead of failing.
findings.impact: A component described as encrypted may hold sensitive payloads in plaintext; later keyed deployment cannot decrypt earlier plaintext. Actual exposure is NOT MEASURED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Require an encryption key at construction (raise if missing/weak), use authenticated encryption with versioned key IDs, and add a test asserting no plaintext bytes are stored.
alternatives: Rename to MaybeEncryptedStore and gate every call on a capability check
Store only a server-side reference, never payload bytes on the device

findings.title: Edge agent state file written non-atomically
findings.evidence_detail: _write calls state_file.write_bytes(blob) in place with no temp file, os.replace or fsync; _read raises StateError on truncated/corrupt ciphertext; the agent polls heartbeat-driven kill/quarantine commands and has no offline task queue.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Inspect _write for atomic-rename and fsync semantics. Falsify by showing temp-file + atomic-replace + directory fsync plus a simulated power-loss test.
findings.root_cause: In-place overwrite of a single state file.
findings.impact: Crash or power loss during write can corrupt state and prevent the edge agent from resuming. Crash-consistency is NOT IMPLEMENTED.
findings.recommended_remediation: Write to a temp file in the same directory, fsync it, os.replace atomically, fsync the directory, keep a last-known-good backup, and add an interruption test.
alternatives: Use an embedded transactional store for agent state
Treat state as disposable and re-fetch from control plane on corruption

findings.title: 'Offline-first' PWA caches only static assets; no clinical data or API cache
findings.evidence_detail: SW registration is the only offline bootstrap; globPatterns cover build assets only; runtime caching covers images and Google Fonts; no client data store or navigator.onLine anywhere in frontend-v3/src.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Go offline and open a patient/order/results view: shell renders but no data loads or queues. Falsify by identifying a client store and offline queue surviving reload and re-syncing online.
findings.root_cause: Offline implemented at asset layer and backend harnesses with no browser persistence.
findings.impact: Browser cannot support offline-first clinical workflows; no offline action survives page reload. Client offline data capability is NOT IMPLEMENTED (corroborates AUD-OFF-003).
findings.recommended_remediation: With owner approval, add an encrypted IndexedDB outbox with idempotency keys, cache only needed reference/read data, wire to the quarantine conflict path, and add an offline→online browser test.
alternatives: Declare the web app online-only and scope offline to a dedicated client
Offer a minimal read-only offline reference cache with explicit 'no clinical data offline' UX

findings.title: Hardcoded Arabic/RTL in document and manifest conflicts with runtime locale switching
findings.evidence_detail: index.html hardcodes lang=ar dir=rtl; manifest hardcodes lang ar / dir rtl; LocaleContext mutates document.documentElement.lang/dir at runtime; 14 literal dir=rtl attributes across 13 .tsx files do not follow runtime direction.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Switch to an LTR locale: document direction changes but component dir attributes and manifest remain RTL, producing mixed-direction layout. Falsify by showing derived dir attributes and per-locale manifests.
findings.root_cause: Direction hardcoded at HTML/manifest/component level rather than derived from one locale source of truth.
findings.impact: Broken layout/accessibility for non-Arabic locales and RTL flash before hydration. Arabic-first defaults are preserved; this is partial i18n, not a constitution violation.
findings.recommended_remediation: Keep Arabic/RTL as default but derive all dir attributes from the locale context; generate per-locale manifests; add a Playwright test switching locale and asserting consistent direction.
alternatives: If only Arabic is supported this release, remove the runtime switch or mark other locales BLOCKED
Use CSS logical properties and drop per-component dir attributes

findings.title: No connectivity/offline UX affordance
findings.evidence_detail: SW registration block has no online/offline event handling or connectivity state; repo-wide search finds no navigator.onLine, connectivity listener, offline banner, or Workbox navigation fallback.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Go offline and navigate to a non-cached route: no explicit offline state is communicated. Falsify by identifying a connectivity provider/banner and a Workbox navigation fallback.
findings.impact: Users cannot distinguish no-network from backend error, cannot tell if an action is queued, and get no guidance — a clinical usability concern.
findings.recommended_remediation: Add a connectivity provider with an Arabic-first offline banner, disable or mark unavailable actions offline, and provide a Workbox navigation fallback; add a browser test toggling connectivity.
alternatives: Surface a minimal 'connection lost — retry' toast on failed requests
Rely on browser native offline page (weak for clinical use)

findings.title: Service-worker update prompt is blocking, unlocalised, and has no registration/offline-ready handling
findings.evidence_detail: registerSW uses blocking confirm() with an inline Arabic string; only onNeedRefresh is supplied; no onOfflineReady, onRegisterError, or i18n key.
findings.reproduction_falsification: Inspect registerSW options. Falsify by showing an i18n-backed non-blocking update UI with explicit offline-ready/error handlers.
findings.root_cause: Minimal PWA scaffold left without UX/i18n integration.
findings.impact: Non-localised blocking prompt in an i18n app; silent SW registration failures leave stale assets unnoticed.
findings.recommended_remediation: Replace confirm() with an accessible in-app dialog using i18n keys; add onOfflineReady and onRegisterError handlers; add an update-path test.
alternatives: Auto-update with skipWaiting and a non-blocking 'new version available' toast
Defer update to next launch with a version indicator
